entries.name: orca
entries.description: Orca lets you run a fleet of bots with your own subscription (e.g. Claude Code, Grok, Agy, Codex). Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 10,291 star（日均约 1,470，相对存量增速 7.2%），累计 143,335 star、9,176 fork。窗口内被 fork 810 次，最近一次提交在 0 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，471 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 10,291 stars over the last 7 days (~1,470/day, 7.2% of its base), now at 143,335 stars and 9,176 forks. 810 new forks in the window; last push 0 day(s) ago; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 471 contributors.

intro.zh: Orca 是一款面向 AI 代理的 IDE，支持在桌面、移动端和远程运行你的机器人。你可以把自己的 Claude、Grok、Codex 等模型接入其中，让机器人在 Slack、Linear 或 GitHub 上帮你修复 bug，甚至在手机上收到提醒并回复。
intro.en: Orca is an AI‑agent IDE that runs on desktop, mobile, and remote runtimes. Plug in your own Claude, Grok, Codex, or other models and let bots fix bugs in Slack, Linear, or GitHub, or get notified on your phone and reply from anywhere.

cardLine.zh: 一站式 AI 代理 IDE，支持多平台、远程、移动交互。
cardLine.en: All‑in‑one AI agent IDE for desktop, mobile, and remote runtimes.

highlights.zh: 在 Slack 或 GitHub 里直接调用机器人修复 bug，返回已测试的 PR。
highlights.en: Invoke bots in Slack or GitHub to fix bugs and get a tested pull request.

highlights.zh: 支持 Chat UI 与 CLI 双模式，随时切换不丢失上下文。
highlights.en: Switch between chat UI and CLI without losing context.

highlights.zh: 可将远程 Orca 服务器与任何 SSH 主机或云 VM 配对，代理持续运行。
highlights.en: Pair a remote Orca server with any SSH host or cloud VM for continuous agent execution.

highlights.zh: 移动 App 让你在离开桌面时也能收到推送并回复，保持工作流不间断。
highlights.en: Mobile app sends push notifications and lets you reply on the go, keeping the workflow continuous.

cons.zh: 开放 issue 10,382 个，相对 star 规模偏高
cons.en: 10,382 open issues — high relative to its star count

fitFor.zh: 探索多智能体协作、角色分工与复杂流水线编排的架构师
fitFor.en: Architects exploring multi-agent collaboration, role assignments, and pipeline orchestration

entries.quickstart:
# 摘自 stablyai/orca 的 README
# macOS (Homebrew)
# Always use the full name; bare `orca` is an unrelated Plotly cask.
brew install --cask stablyai/orca/orca
# Upgrade an existing install
brew upgrade --cask stablyai/orca/orca
# Release candidates (conflicts with the stable cask; uninstall it first)
brew install --cask stablyai/orca/orca@rc

# Arch Linux (AUR) — or stably-orca-git to build from source
yay -S stably-orca-bin

entries.name: firecrawl
entries.description: Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. Search, scrape and access 550+ data providers through one API.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 5,485 star（日均约 784，相对存量增速 2.6%），累计 212,044 star、11,172 fork。窗口内被 fork 416 次，最近一次提交在 0 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，171 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 5,485 stars over the last 7 days (~784/day, 2.6% of its base), now at 212,044 stars and 11,172 forks. 416 new forks in the window; last push 0 day(s) ago; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 171 contributors.

intro.zh: 想让 Agent 会读网页？Firecrawl 把网站抓下来转成干净的 markdown，还能搜索并接入 550 多家数据源，全走一个 API。本地版是个单二进制，一条 init 命令就能挂成 MCP 服务器，Claude Code、Cursor 等工具自动识别接入。
intro.en: Want your agents to read the web? Firecrawl turns websites into clean markdown, adds search, and reaches 550+ data providers through one API. The local build is a single binary; one init command wires it up as an MCP server that Claude Code, Cursor and other tools pick up automatically.

cardLine.zh: 把网页变成干净 markdown：抓取、搜索、550+ 数据源，一个 API 全搞定
cardLine.en: Turns websites into clean markdown: scrape, search and 550+ data providers via one API

highlights.zh: 本地版免数据库免容器，单二进制把网页爬成干净 markdown
highlights.en: Local build needs no database, queue or container — one binary scrapes sites into clean markdown

highlights.zh: init 自动发现 Claude Code、Cursor 等工具并挂载为 MCP 服务器
highlights.en: init finds Claude Code, Cursor and other tools on your machine and adds itself as an MCP server

highlights.zh: 本机 Chrome 渲染 JS 页面，PDF 和 Office 文档也能本地解析
highlights.en: Renders JavaScript pages with the Chrome already on your machine, and parses PDFs and Office docs locally

highlights.zh: serve 在本地起 Firecrawl v2 API，现有 SDK 改个地址即可直连
highlights.en: serve answers the Firecrawl v2 API on localhost, so existing SDKs work by just pointing at it

cons.zh: 暂无独立文档系统（如 Wiki/Docs），查阅细节可能需通读 README
cons.en: No dedicated docs portal — onboarding relies primarily on README

cons.zh: 近 90 天未发布正式 Release 版本
cons.en: No formal releases in the last 90 days

entries.name: impeccable
entries.description: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, catch AI slop before it ships.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 3,529 star（日均约 504，相对存量增速 3%），累计 118,347 star、7,083 fork。窗口内被 fork 286 次，最近一次提交在 0 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，64 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 3,529 stars over the last 7 days (~504/day, 3% of its base), now at 118,347 stars and 7,083 forks. 286 new forks in the window; last push 0 day(s) ago; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 64 contributors.

intro.zh: AI 生成的页面总是千篇一律？Impeccable 给编码 Agent 一套设计词汇：用 polish、bolder 指挥风格，critique、audit 做评审，再用 62 条规则揪出「AI 味」。项目里跑一次 /impeccable init 即可，支持 Claude Code、Cursor 等主流工具。
intro.en: AI-generated pages all look the same? Impeccable gives your coding agent a design vocabulary: steer style with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, and catch AI slop with 62 deterministic rules. Run /impeccable init once per project — it works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, and many more.

cardLine.zh: 给编码 Agent 的设计词汇库：指挥风格、评审设计、揪出 AI 味页面
cardLine.en: A design vocabulary for your coding agent: steer, review, and catch AI slop.

highlights.zh: bolder、polish 等指令精准指挥设计，不用再让 Agent 猜 make it pop 是什么意思
highlights.en: Steer design with commands like bolder and polish — no more guessing what 'make it pop' means

highlights.zh: critique 按可用性启发式打分并排出修复优先级，audit 检查无障碍、性能、响应式，按 P0-P3 分级
highlights.en: critique scores against usability heuristics and ranks fixes; audit checks accessibility, performance, and responsiveness with P0–P3 severity

highlights.zh: 62 条确定性规则揪出 AI 味设计：紫蓝渐变、嵌套卡片、灰字压色底，无需 LLM 和 API key
highlights.en: 62 deterministic rules flag AI slop — purple gradients, nested cards, gray text on color — no LLM or API key needed

highlights.zh: init 与 document 把产品定位、视觉体系写进上下文文件，后续改动不跑偏、不脱离品牌
highlights.en: init and document capture product positioning and your visual system into context files, so later changes stay on-brand

entries.name: graphify
entries.description: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 2,650 star（日均约 379，相对存量增速 1.7%），累计 154,466 star、14,862 fork。窗口内被 fork 313 次，最近一次提交在 0 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，413 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 2,650 stars over the last 7 days (~379/day, 1.7% of its base), now at 154,466 stars and 14,862 forks. 313 new forks in the window; last push 0 day(s) ago; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 413 contributors.

intro.zh: 把整个代码库连同文档、SQL schema、配置甚至 PDF 一起，变成一张可以查询的知识图谱。在 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 助手里输入 /graphify，它就用 tree-sitter 本地解析代码建图，之后你可以直接提问、追踪依赖，而不是在文件里 grep。
intro.en: Turn your whole codebase — code, docs, SQL schemas, configs, even PDFs — into a queryable knowledge graph. Type /graphify in Claude Code, Cursor or another assistant and it maps the project locally with deterministic tree-sitter parsing, so you ask questions and trace dependencies instead of grepping through files.

cardLine.zh: 把代码库变成可查询知识图谱，AI 助手输入 /graphify 即可建图提问
cardLine.en: Turns your codebase into a queryable knowledge graph via a /graphify skill for AI coding assistants.

highlights.zh: 代码用 tree-sitter 本地确定性解析，不调 LLM，数据不出本机。
highlights.en: Code is parsed locally with tree-sitter AST — deterministic, no LLM, nothing leaves your machine.

highlights.zh: 每条边都标注 EXTRACTED 或 INFERRED，直接读自源码还是推断一目了然。
highlights.en: Every edge is tagged EXTRACTED or INFERRED, so you can tell direct reads from inferences.

highlights.zh: 不是向量索引，是可遍历的真实图谱：提问、追路径、解释概念都行。
highlights.en: A real traversable graph, not a vector index: ask questions, trace paths, explain concepts.

highlights.zh: 支持 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Gemini CLI 等 20+ 助手。
highlights.en: Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI and 20+ other assistants.

intro.zh: AI 写的文案常有一股「味儿」，比如「这不仅是功能，更是变革」这种句式。Humanizer 是一个 Agent 技能，基于维基百科编辑识别 AI 文本的指南，检查并改写 26 种典型 AI 写作痕迹，且不改变原意。装进 Claude Code 或 Codex 后，输入 /humanizer 就能把 AI 输出润成更像人写的版本。
intro.en: AI-written copy has a tell — "It's not just a feature, it's a shift." Humanizer is an agent skill built on Wikipedia's guide for spotting AI writing; it rewrites 26 typical AI patterns without changing the meaning. Install it in Claude Code or Codex, run /humanizer, and your AI output reads like a person wrote it.

cardLine.zh: 基于维基百科 AI 写作识别指南的 Agent 技能，改掉 26 种 AI 腔，让文本读起来像人写的
cardLine.en: An agent skill that rewrites 26 AI-writing tells so text reads like a person wrote it.

highlights.zh: 内置 26 种 AI 写作痕迹检查，专治「不仅是 X 更是 Y」这类一眼假的套话
highlights.en: Checks 26 AI-writing patterns, killing clichés like "not X but Y" on sight.

highlights.zh: 盲测 16 次全部胜出：评审更偏好它改写后的文本，且原意保持不变
highlights.en: In a blind test, judges preferred its rewrite over the original AI text 16 out of 16 times.

highlights.zh: 装进 Claude Code、Codex 等支持技能的 Agent，输入 /humanizer 即可调用改写
highlights.en: Works in Claude Code, Codex, and any skill-capable agent — just run /humanizer.

highlights.zh: 明确不追求绕过 AI 检测器，专注让真人读者读起来自然
highlights.en: Explicitly not built to evade AI detectors; it edits for human readers instead.

intro.zh: 把想法、计划或整个代码库变成可交互图表的 Agent Skill。对 Claude Code、Cursor 等说一句话，它就生成可探索、可分享的 HTML 图表，或先给结论、再分板块答疑的单页解读。比如让它读一个仓库，很快拿到带来源引用的架构图。
intro.en: An Agent Skill that turns any idea, plan, or codebase into interactive visuals. Describe what you want to Claude Code, Cursor and friends, and it builds explorable, shareable HTML diagrams—or a one-page answer that leads with the conclusion. Ask it to read a repo and you get a source-cited architecture diagram.

cardLine.en: Turn ideas, plans, or codebases into interactive diagrams and one-page answers.

highlights.zh: 支持 10 种图表类型，覆盖架构诊断、PR 走读等场景

highlights.en: Outputs explorable, shareable interactive HTML—no repo needed, a description works too.

highlights.zh: 答疑页结论先行，论断带编号来源，代码摘录锁定到具体 commit
highlights.en: Answers lead with the conclusion; claims cite numbered sources pinned to a commit.
